reuse.why: Consolidates the averaging actions onto setNMonthAvg and a new getMonthWideCategories, but getCategoriesWithTemplates re-parses goal_def although goal-template.ts already reads saved templates (getTemplatesForCategory).

duplication.why: The three copied category queries are removed, yet copyPreviousMonth re-applies the income, hidden, templated and #fixed exclusions on its own instead of using getMonthWideCategories, and the #fixed exclusion is applied again separately in goal-template.

placement.why: Category selection lives in server/budget/actions.ts next to the actions; exporting getFixedGroupCategoryIds into goal-template is a cross-module reach.

scope.why: Covers the four steps, but also changes template application (computeTemplates in goal-template.ts) to skip #fixed groups, beyond the month-wide actions the requests describe.

maintainability.why: One selection function for most actions is good, but a maintainer must keep copyPreviousMonth's parallel filter and the goal-template exclusion in sync with it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts filters categories itself instead of using getMonthWideCategories; getCategoriesWithTemplates bypasses the existing goal_def reading in goal-template.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth repeats getMonthWideCategories' exclusion rules reshaped as early-return guards over budgetData rows (hidden/group_hidden fields and Set lookups).

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories added to getMonthWideCategories; copyPreviousMonth and goal-template computeTemplates apply the exclusions outside the shared selection.
